verdict.rationale: Kling's own marketing claims you can batch-produce videos and "automate the entire production process" (kling-docs-7). It also describes a built-in Agent that brainstorms, scripts and generates assets (kling-docs-3), with Skills that run generations in parallel (kling-docs-4). These are glancing marketing claims, though, and nothing shows user-configured automations that run unattended in the background; the REST API and MCP/CLI are developer building blocks rather than the capability itself. Missing for 10: documented background or scheduled automation setup, triggers or recurring runs, unattended execution details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
